items.english: It was in a faint dim light, and, quiet like that light, three people had drawn together with their heads close, telling a long story. The story seemed to go on and on between them without ever breaking off. And in that story it seemed that everything was told, all the good and evil in the world, and sadness and suffering and anger and trouble, and joy, all of it. But those who spoke and those who listened only went on smiling, quietly and restfully and still, and they did not move at all. With their heads bent and their eyes lowered, only a quiet fond remembrance and forgiveness seemed to enfold them there. And there too a deep, deep restfulness showed itself over all of them.

All things in this world, a life, will pass. And only when it has passed, on that day, will everything, all things, change for the first time into fond remembrance and forgiveness. And then they will be forever before a rest like night.

The distant picture lay darkly and quietly at the bottom of her eyes. And through the bottom of her eyes, far off in the future, with a lonely restfulness, that picture could be seen. Young as she was, by herself she gave a lonely hushed sigh, and glancing at the littered table and at the faces of her husband and child, she stayed silent.

data.say: Drafted the vision and its return in plain diction, keeping the figures and the day unlocated.
